description: This Java source file defines the CompatibilityRenderTarget class, which implements the IAndroidTarget interface to simulate different Android API levels for rendering purposes in the Android Studio environment. It provides methods to access target properties, compare targets, and delegate resource retrieval to an underlying target.

classes.name: CompatibilityRenderTarget
classes.description: A class that simulates a specific Android API level by delegating to a real target and providing a custom version.

methods.name: CompatibilityRenderTarget
methods.description: Constructor initializing the target with a delegate, API level, and optional real target.

methods.name: getRenderTarget
methods.description: Returns the actual target used for rendering.

methods.name: getRealTarget
methods.description: Returns the simulated real target if available.

methods.name: getDescription
methods.description: Returns the description of the delegate target.

methods.name: getVersion
methods.description: Returns the AndroidVersion object representing the target's version.

methods.name: getVersionName
methods.description: Returns the name of the Android version, e.g., 'Lollipop'.

methods.name: hashString
methods.description: Generates a hash string representing the platform.

methods.name: compareTo
methods.description: Compares this target to another based on API level and delegate comparison.

methods.name: getPath
